The visit

From consultation to finish

  1. 01

    Consultation

    Every appointment starts with a real consultation — your hair, your routine, your goal. Nothing is cut before you both agree on the look.

  2. 02

    Colour

    Hand-painted balayage and lived-in colour, glossed and finished so it grows out gracefully — no harsh lines, no surprises at the mirror.

  3. 03

    Cut

    Precision cutting, styled to your bone structure. The cut is shaped dry and finished wet, so it sits right when you style it at home.

  4. 04

    Finish

    You leave knowing exactly what was done, what it cost, and how to keep it looking right until your next visit. That is the whole point.

The Studio

Not a salon visit — a standing appointment with yourself.

Owner Johnny Diol created Studio 61 in Coral Gables on one belief: great hair is never rushed — and clients stay for years. Inspired by Studio 54 in New York City, he made a space for all to enjoy the “Dance” of Hair. One client has been with Johnny for over 12 years.

— Good to know

Before you book.

Every service lists its duration and price up front — and if it's not right, we make it right. That's our guarantee.

How much will it cost?

Services run from $20 (Boogie Curls) to $280 (Balayage) — prices as listed on the salon's Booksy page. The final price is confirmed at your consultation, before any work begins. Colour is quoted after we see your hair, so the price you approve is the price you pay.

How long will my appointment take?

A cut takes 30–60 minutes; colour and balayage take 90 minutes to 3 hours. Every service lists its duration and time, and your stylist confirms it at booking — no rushing, no surprises.

What if I don't like the result?

If it's not right, we make it right — re-cut, tone or adjust, no charge. That's our guarantee.

What to expect at your first visit

A real consultation first: your stylist looks at your hair, asks how you live with it, and agrees the cut or colour with you before touching a scissor. You leave knowing exactly how to keep the look alive at home.

10% off your first visit

New clients save 10% on their first appointment — mention this page when you book.
